description: Add or remove tags on an item. Edits an item's tags incrementally: attaches every name in `add` (creating project tags as needed) and detaches every name in `remove`, leaving the item's other tags untouched. Matching is case-insensitive; a name in both lists ends up removed.

add.description: Tag names to attach (get-or-created by name, case-insensitive). Already-attached names are a no-op.

items.description: A tag name. Trimmed; matched case-insensitively against the project's existing tags.

entityId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

entityType.description: The kind of item a tag set hangs off: `ops` (any queue item — bug, feature request, error/alert/measure-plan ticket), `flag` (feature gate), `config` (dynamic config), `killswitch`, `metric`, `error` (tracked error group), `alert_rule`, or `experiment`.

remove.description: Tag names to detach (case-insensitive). Names the item doesn't carry are a no-op. A name in both lists is removed.

items.description: A tag name. Trimmed; matched case-insensitively against the project's existing tags.

name: tags_update
